summary: The miniature is recognizable and charming: a compact near-square studio with a low silver-gray hipped roof, deep pale eaves, warm brown walls, one tall narrow window, and a modest side entry. The simplified proportions and repeated visual language are coherent at diorama scale, with no obvious broken geometry or duplicated principal portals.

orientation.summary: The located SV1 camera is southwest of the studio and looks northeast, so it sees the southwest +v face nearly head-on and the southeast +u face obliquely. In SV1, the tall window is on the broad southwest-facing wall while the sole entry is on the receding southeast wall. The labeled render sheet likewise places the window on +v and the only actual door on +u (outward bearing 146° SE), matching the source rather than relying on the nearest-road hint.

issues.problem: The wall treatment reads as uniform brick in the model, while SV1 shows cedar-brown shingle siding, an important part of the studio’s character.
issues.fix: Use a simplified larger-scale shingle pattern or staggered horizontal courses while retaining the warm brown color.
